## Render a variable list as markdown output in a Quarto document {.unnumbered}


### Description

Takes metadata from <code>get_variable_metadata()</code> and outputs formatted
markdown bullet points via <code>cat()</code>. Intended for use in Quarto chunks
with <code>results: asis</code>.



### Usage

<pre><code class='language-R'>render_variable_list(metadata)
</code></pre>


### Arguments

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td style = "white-space: collapse; font-family: monospace; vertical-align: top"><code id="metadata">metadata</code></td>
<td>
A named list as returned by <code>get_variable_metadata()</code>,
where each element contains <code>name</code>, <code>label</code>, and optionally
<code>value_labels</code>.
</td></tr>
</table>


### Value

Called for its side effect of printing markdown to stdout.
Returns <code>NULL</code> invisibly.
